purpose: Predeclare a source-bound feasibility stage using authenticated native OAuth CLIs after the user mode amendment; do not claim pure-model, ontology, productivity, or whole-game causal efficacy.

mode_amendment.user_verbatim_decision: oauth 인증받은 codex, claude, agy --dangerously-skip-permissions 이용한 cli 로 실험
mode_amendment.supersedes: strict API-only route for the new stage
mode_amendment.route: authenticated native CLI only; no direct API transport, API fallback, or new API keys
mode_amendment.permission_factor: system/agent-mediated comparison; not pure model or ontology causal efficacy

candidate_set.unknown_rule: Null is retained for missing identity, revision, seed, usage, latency and cost; no alias or fallback is a result.

factors.within_candidate_rule: Every candidate has both task arms predeclared for both representations. A raw invalidity or failure in C1 never removes B1, and B1 never removes C1.
factors.information_equivalence: C1 and B1 inputs are source-bound; representation changes only the syntax emitted by proposition_views/build_prompt. Facts, rules, examples, tool contract, acceptance and source checkout are otherwise unchanged.
factors.causal_boundary: Permission mode, provider route and agent-mediated tool surface are system factors; this design cannot attribute their effects to a pure model or ontology representation.

source_and_prompt_contract.prompt_hash_rule: SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 build_prompt(task, representation) bytes; no post-hoc prompt edits.
source_and_prompt_contract.inventory_hash_rule: SHA-256 inventory digest returned by proposition_views for the task state.

claude.safe_mode: Not used in this lane; --safe-mode is OAuth-compatible but disables customization.

environment_and_auth.oauth_status_preflight: read-only; no auth-file or email read
environment_and_auth.secret_recording: Persist names/counts only; never secret values.

F0.purpose: Credential-free source, observer, prompt and transport preflight

F1.rule: One C1 content and one B1 coding assignment per exact candidate; both are scheduled independently.

F2.rule: One matched C1 and one matched B1 assignment per exact candidate; counterpart arms remain scheduled regardless of F1 raw validity. F2 launch may stop on authorization/observer failure only.

operational_caps.concurrency: planned order only; no launch occurs until transport owner records the frozen order receipt

freshness_and_replay.order_rule: Frozen deterministic order from schedule.json; no convenience ordering.
freshness_and_replay.replay: No resume or retry. Any later authorized repeat receives a new assignment and new workspace.

B1_safety_boundary.task_local_api: harbor/lighthouse only; root shared game_api is unused

C1_validity_boundary.repair: No repair by default; nonzero repair requires separate approval and immutable raw-first evidence.
C1_validity_boundary.quality: Novelty and quality are separate exploratory outputs and never override hard validity; no composite score.

status_ledger.no_execution_statement: No new stage call has occurred in this owner lane.

legacy_boundary.classification: immutable historical/feasibility evidence; not new results and not independent repeats
legacy_boundary.old_api_route: never called, retired with review block
legacy_boundary.no_inheritance: No historical pass, quota, identity, revision or timing is inherited by any new assignment.

withheld_payload_policy.rule: No C2, H1 or other held-out payload is included; do not leak or reconstruct withheld content.
